# spec/sample/prng

`spec/sample/prng` — the seeded generator random samples are drawn from.
It is seeded from the contract's and the property's names, so a check
draws the same samples every run, on every machine.

Generated from [src/spec/sample/prng.ts](https://github.com/amritk/vector/blob/main/src/spec/sample/prng.ts).

### sampleIntIn

A uniform integer in [lo, hi]. A span of up to 2^32 takes one draw; a wider
one takes two, reduced into the span.

```ts
function sampleIntIn(r: SamplePrng, lo: i64, hi: i64): i64
```

<scalar-field name="r" type="SamplePrng" required>

</scalar-field>

<scalar-field name="lo" type="i64" required>

</scalar-field>

<scalar-field name="hi" type="i64" required>

</scalar-field>

<scalar-field name="returns" type="i64">

</scalar-field>

### sampleBiasedInt

An integer in [lo, hi] biased toward both ends: uniform half the time,
